LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed: top-left (causal chain), top-right (recorded series), bottom-left (bit-pattern strip), and bottom-right (state card).
SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss) in the legend. However, no data lines or points are visible in the plotting area; only a flat orange horizontal line near 0.1 is drawn. The purple circular marker is not visible in the main plot area.
TEXT: Step number: 34 / 59; w value: 1.1519353860595703; loss: 0.00095409574460834265; FPS readout: 8 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s; bits changed: 12 of 32.
BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. The orange squares (changed) correspond to positions approximately 10-14, 17-19, 21, 24, 26, and 31 (from left to right). The hex word is readable as 0x3F935F90.
DEFECTS: The "recorded series (live)" panel is effectively empty of data series despite having a legend and axis labels. Text in the bottom-right state card ("dep" and "step") appears slightly misaligned or overlapping with other elements. The purple marker mentioned in the legend is missing from the plot area.
VERDICT: FAIL (The primary data visualization panel is missing its plotted data series, making it non-functional as a live observatory view).
